title: Not impressed
text:
Not impressed. You're paying for a name and fancy presentation. I had 100% tm egyptainncotton sheets that were heavy and lasted 11 yrs with only alight rips.

These are thin for one. May become soft with wash, idk yet but they will not last 10 years i can tell, they are paper thin. The bordered design is uncomfortable, definitely for looks, it's the only thick part and it feels awkward.

Color is beautiful

These are my initial impressions. Just a firm believer that they don't make them like they used to.
